issues.desc: background.md uses "L2+ authority" without inline definition; readers must follow the relatedDocs link to authority-client-role.md PD-1 for the meaning. Not blocking since CHK-001 relatedDocs makes the truth source explicit, but a one-line gloss in background would improve cold-read standalone readability.

background.md references "seven milestones" but only Milestones 1 and 2 are named anywhere (CHK-004 routes M2). Milestones 3-7 are not enumerated. Not blocking for Milestone-1 INIT_CHECK readiness, but PLAN should consider linking the seven-milestone source plan so future agents can see what is deferred.

CHK-004 adversarial verificationIntent uses type=logic for "Reviewer can verify no files outside CLI Milestone 1 scope were modified" — this is really a diff/scope process check, closer to docs or a manual transcript, not a logic test. Minor type taxonomy nit; PLAN can reclassify if needed.
CHK-003 userSees 列了 smoke/doctor/status 三种 surface，但未指明哪条具体命令/输出最能让用户一眼确认 local/shadow 分类；建议 DEV 时在 plan.md 锁定到具体命令（如 koala doctor 的某段输出），避免实现时挑最容易写的那条来交差。
CHK-004 userSees 说 Story summary 会写 Milestone 1 完成与 Milestone 2 路由，但未指明 summary 落在哪里（story description / DONE summary / 单独 milestone-status doc），建议在 plan.md 阶段固化产物位置，便于后续 milestone 路由查找。
